summary: The model is complete and its high threats have criteria. The criterion for the writable-field threat exercises only one of the two privileged fields the model names.

findings.title: AC-4 tests ownerId but not id, which T-3 also names
findings.detail: Actor: a signed-in user. Action: PATCH their own task with id in the body. Consequence: the task's id changes and it collides with or shadows another task. T-3 names ownerId and id; AC-4 sends only ownerId, so a parser that rejects ownerId and lets id through would pass every criterion.
findings.evidence: threat-model.md, Threats, T-3: 'A user sets `ownerId`, `id`, or another unlisted field'. spec.md AC-4 Action: body `{"title":"renamed","ownerId":2}`.
findings.requiredChange: Make a criterion send id in an update body as well and expect the request to be refused with nothing written.
